notes: Breastfeeding conflict: NHS pregnancy page says acceptable, NHS who-can page lists breastfeeding as a situation to check and some UK SmPCs advise against; review. NHS side-effects page text itself was only seen via summary (common list unconfirmed beyond constipation/headache/sick). 'Pounding' heartbeat not found in NHS text. Water-absorption and opioid-receptor statements re-attributed to product labels (SmPC/FDA label); US FDA must stay marked US. 'same day' wording removed as unsupported cut-off. MedlinePlus page appears old (about 3,000 days); MHRA Drug Safety Update (gov.uk) also covers cardiac risk and could be cited for a UK source. UC/Crohn's prescription sentences rest on summaries of NHS About page. The class page caution wording 'flare-up of ulcerative colitis' omits other inflammatory conditions; fine. | Editorial tidy-ups after the second pass (duplicate sentences removed or one wording softened) are marked in the claims where they apply. Replacement sentences came from the second-pass retrieval and were not run through a third check.
